class.name: CgameGuildSync
class.brief_description: Replicated guild state with deterministic, order-independent conflict resolution.
class.description: [CgameGuildSync] keeps one replica of the guild documents on every server. Local edits ([method join], [method set_rank], [method kick], [method set_motd], [method deposit]) are logged as operations with a Lamport timestamp and returned so the caller can push them; [method receive] applies remote operations and [method sync_from] performs pull-based anti-entropy using version vectors. Operations are commutative and idempotent, so replicas converge regardless of delivery order or duplication. Conflict policy: rank and message of the day are last-writer-wins by (Lamport clock, origin server); a kick wins over a concurrent rank change or join, and a member only returns through a join that has seen the kick; treasury deposits are summed per unique operation id so a replayed deposit never counts twice.

method.name: join
method.description: Adds a player to a guild and returns the operation to replicate.

method.name: set_rank
method.description: Changes a member's rank and returns the operation to replicate.

method.name: kick
method.description: Removes a member and returns the operation to replicate.

method.name: set_motd
method.description: Sets the message of the day and returns the operation to replicate.

method.name: deposit
method.description: Adds gold to the guild treasury and returns the operation to replicate.

method.name: receive
method.description: Applies a remote operation. Returns [code]true[/code] if it was new; safe to call repeatedly and out of order.

method.name: ops_after
method.description: Returns the logged operations a replica with the version vector [param remote_vv] has not seen.

method.name: sync_from
method.description: Pulls the missing operations from another replica (any object with [code]ops_after()[/code]) and applies them in timestamp order. Returns the number of new operations.

method.name: is_member
method.description: Returns whether the player is currently a guild member.

method.name: rank_of
method.description: Returns the member's rank, or [code]-1[/code] for non-members.

method.name: members
method.description: Returns the sorted ids of the current members.

method.name: motd
method.description: Returns the message of the day.

method.name: version
method.description: Returns how many operations have been applied to the guild.

method.name: digest
method.description: Returns a canonical string of the player-visible state. Equal digests mean converged replicas.

members.member: Id of the server that owns this replica.
Guild documents keyed by guild id.
Every known operation keyed by its id ([code]"origin:seq"[/code]).
Version vector: origin server (as a string) to the highest contiguous sequence applied.
